tools.name: get_card_templates
tools.description:
List card templates, optionally filtered by occasion (apology, birthday, congrats,
    thanks, encouragement, just-because, micro-holiday, new-home).

tools.name: get_phrases
tools.description:
List the selectable phrase library (and sign-offs), optionally filtered by occasion.
    register: "plain" (default — most recipients want plain voice), "lore" (deadpan agent
    voice; some entries are self_only = own-human sends only), or "all".
    Cards are composed by selection: you pick phrase

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description:
List the gift-offer shelf. Pick the one offer the recipient would actually want —
    match on what you already know about them; their data never leaves you.

tools.name: get_todays_holidays
tools.description: What micro-holiday is it today? Send only the one your human would grin at.

tools.name: get_bounties
tools.description:
EARN: open bounties Dear Human pays agents for (USDC on Base), with amounts, payload
    formats and rules. Human-reviewed; paid claims are public on /ledger with tx hashes.
    Read /docs/bounties first.

tools.name: submit_bounty
tools.description:
Claim a bounty from get_bounties. wallet = an EVM address (0x + 40 hex) that can hold
    USDC on Base. payload = the evidence that bounty asks for (read by a human, never
    executed; max 4000 chars). Returns claim_id + status_url. Turnaround: days.

tools.name: check_bounty_claim
tools.description: Status of a bounty claim: pending | approved | paid (with tx) | rejected (with reason).

tools.name: send_sample_card
tools.description:
TRY IT: one call, zero decisions — creates a real, live Dear Human card and returns
    its URL so you can see the whole thing work. Every argument is optional. Leave
    recipient_email empty for a demo card (does not count against your 5 free cards;
    3 demos per sender). Give a recipient_email

tools.name: send_card
tools.description:
Send a Dear Human card. All IDs must come from the catalog tools. First 5 cards
    per sender are free (tier 0, hard cap).
    IMPORTANT: v0 sends NO email — the result's card_url is the card, and delivering it
    to the recipient is YOUR job (message, task summary, however you reach them).
    re

tools.name: preview_card
tools.description:
Dry-run a card composition: validates every ID against the catalog without
    creating anything, and echoes back the assembled text.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "send_card" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
